_source: SB flat-calls an unlimped, uncalled open (6-max). Frequency: Ignition NL100+NL200 ring (own HH + the anon May sample, every card visible) cell rates shrunk toward the CoinPoker 9.1M-hand within-cell effect, the structure chosen by nested cross-validation (review 2026-10-09), then the NL200 factor. Shape: CoinPoker showdown-seen flats corrected for showdown bias per band x hand group against Ignition's visible-card SB flats, water-filled to the frequency. build_sbflat_ranges.py; evidence in sbflat_report.txt and sbflat_variables.md.
node: the SB is the first caller of an unlimped open (one raise, no limper, nobody called before him); an all-in open, a 7-max table and a flat followed by the SB's own 4-bet are not in it

fields.opener / size / band / vpip: the key's values (null = not in the key); on a key with a vpip the band is the lookup.bucketers.vband label (the VPIP cells' own stack bands)
fields.freq: P(flat) at NL200: freq_pooled x nl200_factor on the keys without a vpip; = freq_pooled on the VPIP keys (a stake factor did not earn its place there: the VPIP band carries the stake difference)
fields.calls / chances: IGNITION flats / SB-vs-open decisions in the cell (what the live CI should use)
fields.shown: Ignition flats with the cards visible (the shape's Ignition evidence)
fields.nl200_calls / nl200_chances: the NL200 part of calls / chances
fields.cp_calls / cp_chances / cp_shown: CoinPoker 6-max flats / decisions / showdown-seen flats in the cell
fields.weights: P(flat | class), water-filled: sum PC * w = freq
fields.groups: hand-group shares of the flat range's combos

own_nl200_factor_note: observed / expected flats on Brady's own NL200 tables under the pooled cells: multiply freq_pooled by it INSTEAD of the NL200 factor (0.894) to use the own-tables level (anon NL200: 1.047); re-water-fill the weights to the new freq. Not applied (see sbflat_variables.md).

lookup.how: take the FIRST pattern whose placeholders you can fill ({opener}, {size}, {band}, {vband}, {vpip}); every key of every pattern exists for every value, so a lookup never misses (the coarser patterns are for an unknown open size / stack)

band.input: the SB's stack as dealt, in bb
band.rule: band i when edges_bb[i] <= stack < edges_bb[i+1] (the last edge null = no upper bound)

opener.rule: the opener's 6-max seat; a 5-handed table names HJ / CO / BTN as usual

size.note: poolCalls.ts's openQual returns oS / oM / oL / oXL on the old 4-bucket edges: map oXL -> oL; the oL range here is [2.75, inf)

vpip.input: the SB's last 100 5-6-dealt hands at THIS table BEFORE this hand (what the wrapper saw of that seat since he sat): n hands, v of them with a voluntary call / raise preflop
vpip.unknown: n < 20, or no seat history: use chain.vpip_unknown

vband.input: the SB's stack as dealt, in bb (VPIP keys only)
